observations: Three photos show the same dusty used automatic transmission/transfer case assembly lying on bare dirt ground at what looks like a used-parts yard.
A watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.' across all three photos, confirming these are stock/listing photos from a parts dealer.
Wiring harness connectors (one purple, one white multi-pin) dangle loose from the bellhousing area, unconnected to anything that could power-test them.
A yellow paint dot and a faint stamped number (possibly '39' or similar) are visible on the transfer case bell in photo 2, but it is too small/worn to read reliably.
No manufacturer plate, casting number, or part-number sticker is legible in any photo.
No fluid pan, dipstick, or drain plug is clearly visible to judge fluid condition or leaks.
Surface is covered in dried mud/dust; no oil wetness or metal shavings are visible, but this does not rule out internal wear.
Item appears to be a bare transmission + transfer case unit only; no torque converter, mounts, or driveshaft flanges are clearly shown attached.

identity.kind: used automatic transmission with transfer case (gearbox), claimed for Ford Expedition V8 4WD

claims.claim: Direct Belgium (i.e., imported used part from Belgium)
claims.evidence: No shipping tag, customs label, or country-of-origin marking visible in any photo.
No legible part number, casting mark, or Ford logo visible in photos 0-2; shape is consistent with a truck/SUV transmission but cannot be confirmed as Expedition-specific.

claims.claim: Implied working/good condition (standard for such listings)
claims.evidence: No bench test, fluid check, or shaft-rotation clip shown; condition cannot be assessed from static photos.

risks.risk: Internal gear/clutch pack condition and whether unit shifts or turns freely
risks.proof: Video of output shaft and transfer case input being rotated by hand, and/or a bench/stand test showing gear engagement
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Fitment mismatch — part number not confirmed to match Ford Expedition V8 4WD specifically
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the casting/part number tag on the transmission case or transfer case
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified generic used transmission, not guaranteed fitment

risks.risk: Missing components (torque converter, mounting brackets, sensors) not included in sale
risks.proof: Full-angle photo showing torque converter and all mounts attached, plus itemized list of what is included
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming only bare case + internals, no converter/mounts included

risks.risk: Water/dirt ingress or corrosion inside casing from outdoor dirt storage
risks.proof: Photo of drained fluid color/smell description plus photo with valve body or pan removed
risks.if_unproven: priced as high risk of internal corrosion

risks.risk: Electrical connectors/sensors (speed sensor, solenoids) functionality unknown
risks.proof: Continuity test video or photos of sensor pins with multimeter reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensors non-functional, needing replacement

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of any stamped part/casting number on the transmission and transfer case
Video of the input/output shafts being rotated by hand to show free movement and gear engagement
Photo or video showing the torque converter and confirming what exactly is included in the sale
Any paperwork or import sticker supporting the 'Direct Belgium' sourcing claim
response.reason: The item can be identified by type as a used transmission/transfer case assembly, but since fitment, functionality, and completeness are all unverified from the photos, it must be priced at worst case (non-working, unconfirmed fitment, parts only) until further proof is supplied.
